editorSelection.selectedText:
Dear Evotym team,

I’ve spent most of my career in fintech and crypto, and I’m writing to introduce myself rather than to apply for one specific role.

I began in content and communication, then moved into UX writing, UX research, and eventually product management. The industry stayed the same throughout, but each role gave me a different view of it. Most recently I worked as an Associate Product Manager on an AI-powered product, collaborating closely with engineers and running user research to turn complex technical capabilities into something people could genuinely use.

That range was deliberate rather than accidental. Writing the words a user reads taught me how much clarity matters in financial products, research taught me how differently people behave from the way we assume they will, and product management taught me what a business needs a product to achieve. Having worked in all three, I tend to see problems that are easy to miss from any one of them alone.

I’m drawn to technology while it’s still taking shape. That is what brought me to crypto, and more recently to AI. I started working with AI early, not only to help build products but also within the user and UX research. That intersection is still where I find the most interesting problems.

What I’m looking for now is a place where that mix is genuinely useful and where I can keep learning. I don’t have a fixed job title in mind, which is exactly why I’d rather introduce myself and hear where you think I might fit.

My CV is attached, and if my background is of interest, I would be glad to have a conversation.

Best,

Yalda
